composing_text: Infantry already on the island and the regiment landing this week, as described in Miller, chapter IX.
source_locator: R2225: ch. IX; R2227: Part VI, ch. 9
notes: Patch, commanding general of the Americal Division, assumed command of troops ashore on 9 December 1942, relieving Vandegrift. Americal headquarters was then the highest headquarters on the island, acting as island, division and partial Marine headquarters until XIV Corps was activated on 2 January 1943 (Miller, ch. IX).
